visuals.caption: Hypertrophic scar (left) stays inside the wound outline; a keloid (right) spreads beyond it.

manage.lead: Silicone and steroid first; procedures are specialist.

points: **Silicone gel or sheet** for months; pressure for earlobes.
Intralesional steroid, cryotherapy, pulsed dye laser, excision with adjuvant (high recurrence).

items.t: Rapidly growing or atypical ‘keloid’: exclude a tumour.

quiz.q: Key difference between keloid and hypertrophic scar?
quiz.a: Keloids extend beyond the original wound; hypertrophic scars do not.

quiz.q: Which skin types are most keloid-prone?
quiz.a: Skin of colour (Fitzpatrick IV–VI), with family history.
Silicone gel or sheet for months.
Keloids recur in most cases without adjuvant therapy.
